case_number: 2025 INSC 203; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 [Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 9218 of 2024]

parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.

summary: FIR lodged after divorce petition; omnibus allegations under IPC 498A, 504, 506 and Dowry Prohibition Act; charge under IPC 376 dropped post-investigation; no protest by complainant; High Court dismissed quashing petition under Section 482 CrPC; Supreme Court finds FIR lacks specificity, time, date; allegations weakened after exclusion of serious charge; reliance on Iqbal alias Bala, Monica Kumar, Mala Kar, Arun Jain, P.V. Krishnabhat; precedent on limited scope of quashing at pre-trial stage; High Court erred in not considering post-investigation developments and diluted allegations; no material to sustain criminal proceedings; divorce decree and remarriage noted.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order quashing petition set aside; criminal proceedings quashed.
